source.event: Vor einem Ladenlokal in einer Einkaufsstraße liegen Scherben und Gegenstände auf dem Boden. Ein Mann verteidigt den beschädigten Eingangsbereich eines Geschäfts, wird dabei von Passanten konfrontiert und körperlich angegriffen. Umstehende greifen deeskalierend ein und rufen zum Aufhören auf, woraufhin der Mann sichtbar mitgenommen im zerstörten Schaufensterrahmen stehen bleibt.

script.title: Anime Riot Archives
script.logline: A devoted archivist protects his sanctuary of classic animation against a chaotic street riot, inspiring unexpected solidarity from local youths.
script.logline_de: Ein hingebungsvoller Architekt verteidigt sein Refugium klassischer Animation gegen Straßenkrawalle und inspiriert unerwartete Solidarität.
script.headline: AI turned a street riot into a 90s anime and it's too real

setting.color_palette: Desaturated gritty urban tones with vivid neon magazine hues
setting.art_style: 1990s retro anime, cel shading, film grain, dramatic lighting, speed lines

characters.name: Ren
characters.design_sheet: 32-year-old male archivist, short messy dark hair, intense brown eyes, wearing a black oversized hoodie with a subtle green collar graphic and dark joggers, thick-rimmed square glasses, focused resolute expression
inspired_by_scene_de: Schwarzer Hoodie und dunkle Hosen als Kleidungstyp
characters.voice: Gravelly, deep, resolute voice like a classic 90s English dub veteran

characters.name: Kaito
characters.design_sheet: 18-year-old male youth, messy white hair, sharp green eyes, wearing a white utility jacket and dark cargo pants, fierce determined expression
changed_de: Weißes Haar und Gesichtszüge völlig anders
characters.voice: Energetic, bright teenage dub voice, slightly raspy

shots.camera: Wide shot, low angle, fast push-in
shots.action: Shattered glass flies across the storefront while Ren stands firm inside the debris.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, wide shot of a ruined storefront, scattered debris and broken glass on the street, c1 Ren with short messy dark hair, black oversized hoodie, thick-rimmed square glasses, standing amid shattered glass, dramatic orange sunset lighting, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Fast camera push-in toward the shattered doorway with flying glass shards and dynamic speed lines.

shots.action: Ren clenches his fists, looking out at the chaotic street with intense determination.

dialogue.line: You will not destroy this place!

shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, medium close-up of c1 Ren with short messy dark hair, black oversized hoodie, thick-rimmed square glasses, shouting angrily, sweat drop on temple, harsh neon reflections, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Camera shakes slightly with impact frames and glowing aura lines around Ren's fists.

shots.action: Shadowy figures surge forward past the broken window frame, clashing against Ren's position.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, over-the-shoulder view of c1 Ren in black hoodie facing anonymous hooded rioters in a debris-filled street, dramatic high-contrast shadows, cel-shaded highlights
shots.motion_prompt: Fast panning motion with motion blur on background figures rushing past.

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye level, rapid cut
shots.action: Kaito steps directly into the fray, holding out his arms to shield Ren from the advancing crowd.

dialogue.line: Back off! Stop this right now!

shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c2 Kaito with white hair, white utility jacket, standing protectively in front of c1 Ren, arms outstretched, street littered with paper and debris, dramatic backlighting
shots.motion_prompt: Fast zoom into Kaito's determined face with flying debris crossing the frame.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up on eyes, slow motion
shots.action: Ren's eyes widen in sudden surprise as he realizes neighborhood youths are standing up for him.
shots.music: Music cuts to a soft, resonant synth chord
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, extreme close-up of c1 Ren's eyes behind thick-rimmed square glasses, reflection of glowing lights in pupils, emotional shock expression, dramatic anime shading
shots.motion_prompt: Slow zoom into the pupils with subtle light refraction and gentle pulsing glow.

shots.camera: Low angle wide shot, dramatic upward tilt
shots.action: A surge of protective energy flares around the group standing together in the broken storefront frame.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c1 Ren and c2 Kaito standing side-by-side in a ruined storefront, glowing yellow energy aura around them, vibrant pop-culture poster in the background, dramatic upward angle
shots.motion_prompt: Energy aura pulses outward with camera shaking and speed lines converging on the characters.

shots.action: Ren stands calmly inside the damaged doorway next to a retro poster, breathing steadily as calm returns.
